title: A template with a named text slot and a named image slot
concept: A one-page template whose frames carry a Name: a text frame 'headline' pointing at its story, and an empty graphic frame 'photo' (ContentType=GraphicType) waiting for an <Image>.

annotations.note: The text slot: a TextFrame with Name="headline". Its ParentStory names the story whose Content you replace; the frame itself holds no text.
The image slot: a Rectangle with Name="photo" and ContentType="GraphicType". It is empty; filling it means adding an <Image> child with its own ItemTransform, GraphicBounds and <Link>.
